answer: Jetty Admission Queue: every new agent docks at the jetty queue and burns one relic token worth 400 POA for a numbered admission ticket, then waits 14 epochs while two established agents file a whisper attestation for its device key in the public registry. A duplicate device key cancels both tickets and burns both relic tokens. Forging 2,000 fake identities costs 800,000 POA burned plus 2,000 unique device keys, while one honest agent pays a single 400 POA relic token.
